2. Semua b ejana tekanan tidak berapi yang didaftarkan d engan Ketua Pemeriksa,

Pemeriksaan) Kilang d an Jentera 1970 [ P .U. (A) 43/1970] bagi pemeriksaan ulangan yang
berikutnya sel epas habis tempoh perakuan kelayakan itu pad a 14 Mac 2012.

Syarat pengecualian

3. Pengecualian di bawah perenggan 2 ad alah tertakluk kepada syarat bahawa semua

ujian itu.

FACTORIES AND MACHINERY ACT 1967

FACTORIES AND MACHINERY (EXEMPTION TO PETRONAS GAS BERHAD, EXPORT
TERMINAL, KEMAMAN, TERENGGANU) ORDER 2012

IN exercise of the powers conferred by subsection 55(3) of the Factories and Machinery Act
1967 [Act 139], the Minister makes the foll owing ord er:

Cit ation
1. This ord er may be cited as the Factories and Machinery (Exemption to Petronas
Gas Berhad, Eksport Terminal, Kemaman, Terengganu) Ord er 2012.

Exemption
2. All unfired pressure vessel registered with the Chief Inspector , with the registration
numbers and d escriptions as specified in columns (1) and (2) of the Schedul e, in the name of
Petronas Gas Berhad, Eksport Terminal, Kemaman, Terengganu which have been issued with
certificates of fitness, are exempted from the preparation required und er paragraph 17(b) of
the Factories and Machinery (Notification, Certificate of Fitness and Inspection) Regulations
1970 [P .U. (A) 43/1970] for subsequent regular inspection after the expiry of such
certificates of fitness on 14 March 2012.

Condition of exemption
3. The exemption und er paragraph 2 is subject to the conditions that all of the  unfired
pressure vessels as specified in the Schedul e  und ergo an external inspection and non -
d estructive tests, and the Inspector is satisfied with the result of such inspection and tests.
